# Inline SVG test

Each case below tries to show the same `badge-maker` badge (label `inline`, message `svg`) a different way, to see which ones GitHub renders.

## 1. Markdown image with a base64 data URI

[![inline svg](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://npmx.dev/package/badge-maker)

## 2. HTML `<img>` with a base64 data URI

<img alt="inline svg" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,">

## 3. Raw inline `<svg>` markup

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="68" height="20" role="img" aria-label="inline: svg"><title>inline: svg</title><filter id="blur"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="16"/></filter><linearGradient id="s" x2="0" y2="100%"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#bbb" stop-opacity=".1"/><stop offset="1" stop-opacity=".1"/></linearGradient><clipPath id="r"><rect width="68" height="20" rx="3"/></clipPath><g clip-path="url(#r)"><rect width="39" height="20" fill="#211f1f"/><rect x="39" width="29" height="20" fill="#3178c6"/><rect width="68" height="20" fill="url(#s)"/></g><g fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Verdana,Geneva,DejaVu Sans,sans-serif" text-rendering="geometricPrecision" font-size="110"><g transform="scale(.1)"><g aria-hidden="true" fill="#010101"><text x="205" y="150" fill-opacity=".8" filter="url(#blur)" textLength="290">inline</text><text x="205" y="150" fill-opacity=".3" textLength="290">inline</text></g><text x="205" y="140" textLength="290">inline</text></g><g transform="scale(.1)"><g aria-hidden="true" fill="#010101"><text x="525" y="150" fill-opacity=".8" filter="url(#blur)" textLength="190">svg</text><text x="525" y="150" fill-opacity=".3" textLength="190">svg</text></g><text x="525" y="140" textLength="190">svg</text></g></g></svg>
